description: Scam / fraud likelihood for messages, DMs, emails, posts and listings: 16 pattern families (crypto doubling giveaways, seed-phrase and private-key solicitation, wallet-connect / airdrop lures, fake support, guaranteed-return and pig-butchering investment pitches, advance-fee, gift-card / wire / crypto-ATM payment, off-platform WhatsApp / Telegram pushes, job-task scams, credential and OTP requests, recovery scams, urgency and account threats) plus link and text signals (URL shorteners, IP and punycode links, crypto addresses, homoglyph words, invisible characters, shouting). Returns 0-100 score, label and evidence spans. Batch up to 50 texts. Offline heuristics, not a verdict. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/scam-text-score
name: scam_text_score
